name: Dallas
seo_title: Christmas Events for Kids in Dallas, OR 2026
seo_desc: Christmas events for kids in Dallas, Oregon for 2026: Christmas Town with a light parade, tree lighting and Santa, plus a movie and a Monmouth tree lighting.
lede: Dallas, Oregon turns downtown into Christmas Town with a light parade, a tree lighting on Courthouse Square, Santa, markets and a hometown movie, and nearby Monmouth adds a university tree lighting.
celebrates: The Dallas Downtown Association presents Christmas Town on Courthouse Square and Main Street, with a parade, a concert, the tree lighting and Santa, plus markets at the Dallas Event Center and The Majestic. The association also runs a holiday lights contest and a decorating day before the big night. In nearby Monmouth, Western Oregon University holds its annual Holiday Tree Lighting with cocoa, a light parade, Santa photos and cookie decorating. Local schools and the senior center add choirs and nutcracker displays.
lastyear: We did not find a published 2025 recap for Dallas holiday events, so this page leans on the hosts' own pages. The downtown association says each year's Christmas Town tree is donated by a local nursery, and Western Oregon University describes its tree lighting as an annual event.
facts: The Dallas Downtown Association says each year's tree is donated by Oregon Olive Trees Nursery and delivered by Mountain View Tree Service, and its committee has a five year goal of bringing an ice skating rink to Dallas. Dallas is the Polk County seat, and the Christmas Town tree stands on Courthouse Square. Western Oregon University in Monmouth lights a large Sequoia tree each December.
trains: Dallas does not have a holiday train that we could verify. Families who want train fun can look to the Oregon Electric Railway Museum at Powerland Heritage Park in Brooks, which is listed on our museum guide.
train_links: A railway museum at Powerland Heritage Park, listed on our museum guide.

faq: How does Dallas, Oregon celebrate Christmas?

The Dallas Downtown Association hosts Christmas Town with a light parade, a tree lighting on Courthouse Square, Santa, markets, school choirs and a movie. Nearby Monmouth adds a Western Oregon University tree lighting. Our listings link to each host.
Is there a Christmas parade in Dallas, Oregon?
Yes. Christmas Town includes a Light Parade through downtown, presented by the Dallas Downtown Association. Public parades are free to watch.
Does Santa visit Christmas Town in Dallas?
Yes. The association lists Santa visits and pictures right after the tree lighting on Courthouse Square.
Is there a tree lighting near Dallas, Oregon?
Yes, two. Christmas Town lights the Courthouse Square tree in Dallas, and Western Oregon University lights its campus tree in nearby Monmouth the night before.
Can kids see a movie in Dallas at Christmas?
The Dallas Downtown Association lists a screening of A Christmas Story at Dallas Cinema as part of Christmas Town, for 2 dollars or two canned food items.
intro_html:
Rally the corgi has sniffed out the best Christmas events for kids in Dallas, Oregon for 2026, and here is what he found: 4 family events, 1 of them free. They all fall in the first weekend of December, with the Western Oregon University Holiday Tree Lighting and Light Parade in nearby Monmouth (December 4) and Christmas Town in downtown Dallas (December 5), which brings a movie at 1 pm, school choirs, nutcracker displays, the light parade at 5 pm, the tree lighting at 6 pm and Santa at 6:05 pm. We check every date on the host's own website, and each listing links straight there.

What Rally found in Dallas

  • Parades and tree lightings: the Christmas Town Light Parade (December 5) and the WOU Light Parade and tree lighting in Monmouth (December 4)
  • Movie and displays: A Christmas Story at Dallas Cinema for 2 dollars or two canned food items (December 5), plus school choirs and nutcracker displays
  • Season: December 4 to December 5
